review:
Triple Pot Gold features bats, dragons and tigers. Money symbols worth 2x to 500x land on reels 1 to 4 and are collected by symbols on reel five.

Bat, dragon and tiger scatters can trigger six free spins, each adding reel multipliers: bats put 2x and 3x on reels one and two, dragons put 3x, 5x and 3x on reels two to four, and tigers put 3x and 2x on reels four and five. If all three are active, reel three gets 10x. Scatters during the bonus add three spins, and multipliers stack. The in-game screens advertise up to 5,000x. Note the RTP is 96.02%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
